fieldNotes.truckGate: No controlled truck entrance. Balcones occupies the historic multi-story Texas Fireproof Storage Company building, which fronts directly onto the downtown Waco street grid (S 11th St). No barrier arm, sliding gate, or checkpoint - trucks load from the public street / alley.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth - this is a downtown urban building with no yard.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Multi-story historic warehouse with overhead/roll-up service doors on the alley (west) side; ~2 truck-usable loading points estimated, band 0-10, medium confidence. No conventional dock-leveler bank.
fieldNotes.dropArea: No trailer parking on site; no yard space.
fieldNotes.drivewayShort: No driveway/approach of meaningful length - the loading face meets the public alley/street directly.
fieldNotes.backupSensitive: Tight downtown geometry: any truck servicing the building backs in directly from a public street/alley with no off-street stacking room.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Single building on a roughly 1.1-acre downtown parcel.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: One historic building houses all distilling operations.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Downtown Waco, inside the dense urban industrial fabric - Urban.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur into the property.
fieldNotes.general: Per The Spirits Business, production was paused September 2025; the site continues with tasting room / visitor operations, so truck activity is minimal.
